answer: A glacier escrow holds 90% of a new key's rewards and thaws 1/30 per epoch, but only while the key keeps passing audits. A kernel of 500 long-lived keys sends a whisper challenge, a random task due in 60 seconds, to 5% of escrowed keys each epoch; a miss forfeits that key's whole glacier balance to the pool, so a fake farm can't idle cheaply. A fake earning 10 POA per epoch locks 9 of it. Attacker pays 9,000 POA locked and exposed to forfeiture this epoch for 1,000 fakes.
